mode: Built-in image_gen, new images, genuine transparent backgrounds
power: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready RPG pixel-art sprite atlas with genuine transparent background. Exactly four isolated assets in a clean 2 by 2 grid, equal square cells, wide empty gutters. Top-left: charming flower-town cottage, rose-pink tiled roof, cream walls, centered front door at bottom, flower window boxes. Top-right: small coastal power station building, pale concrete walls, teal industrial roof, electrical equipment and a centered front door at bottom. Bottom-left: a bank of blue solar panels on low metal supports viewed from above and slightly south, three panels together. Bottom-right: complex industrial generator machinery with coils, control lights and pipes, compact rectangular floor footprint. Consistent top-down 3/4 overworld 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, soft limited palette, light upper left, no text, no characters, no ground/background, no shadow extending far outside objects. Each object fully visible centered inside its own quadrant, no overlap. This will be sliced into four separate game map props.
flowers: Use case: stylized-concept. A production sprite sheet of four isolated RPG overworld pixel-art assets, genuinely transparent alpha background, perfectly separated 2x2 equal square cells with generous transparent gutters. Upper left: dense patch of small pink, lavender and white wildflowers growing from short muted green leaves, no soil square, view from above. Upper right: dense patch of yellow, coral and white flowers with muted green leaves, no soil square. Lower left: small coastal passenger ferry, white hull, blue roof, gold trim, side-front 3/4 view facing right, suitable for dock in top-down RPG, no letters or logos. Lower right: a small ornamental round-canopy flowering tree with pale pink blossoms, visible brown trunk and restrained grass shadow. Consistent charming 16-bit pixel art, crisp limited palette, no anti-aliasing, no people, no text. All four objects fully visible inside quadrants, no parts touch cell borders. These are reusable map sprites, not a composed scene.
machines: Use case: stylized-concept. Four different reusable top-down 3/4 16-bit RPG power-plant interior props on genuine transparent alpha background. 2x2 equal square cells, wide empty margins, no overlap, each fully inside quadrant. Top left: rectangular bank of electrical control consoles with blue screens, switches, and wiring. Top right: two industrial cylindrical transformer tanks with brass coils and ceramic insulators. Bottom left: floor-mounted silver pipe manifold with valves and a small pressure pump. Bottom right: heavy enclosed turbine unit with blue housing, a large ventilation grille and thick cable. Crisp pixel art, grey steel, teal and brass palette, same 3/4 overhead angle, light from upper left. No text, no people, no floor/background. These props will form a machinery maze in a Japanese RPG.
